title: Oligonucleotide CDMO Market to Reach USD 9.87 Billion by 2031 as RNA-Targeted Drug Pipelines Expand
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global oligonucleotide contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) market is experiencing strong growth driven by expanding RNA-targeted medicine pipelines, increased outsourcing of complex synthesis and manufacturing, and rising demand for precision medicine. The market is projected to grow at a 21.81% CAGR through 2031, with contract manufacturing leading at 51.68% market share in 2025. Antisense oligonucleotides dominate at 58.23% revenue, while siRNA is the fastest-growing segment at 23.25% CAGR. Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 24.56% CAGR, driven by capacity expansion in China, South Korea, and Japan.

title: Complement Inhibitors Market Outlook Remains Strong During the Forecast Period (2026–2036) with Increasing Adoption of C5 and C3 Targeted Drugs | DelveInsight
author: Delveinsight
description: The complement inhibitors market is projected to experience strong growth through 2036, driven by rising prevalence of complement-mediated diseases, increased R&D efforts, and approval of new therapeutic agents. The US represents the largest market, with IgAN showing approximately 135,000 diagnosed prevalent cases. Key emerging therapies from major pharmaceutical companies are expected to expand treatment options across multiple indications including PNH, aHUS, CIDP, and IgAN.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: ULTOMIRIS (ravulizumab) successfully achieved primary endpoint in Phase III trial for IgAN in April 2026, with patent protection extending to 2035-2040 across major markets, positioning the company favorably in the growing complement inhibitors market.
FABHALTA (iptacopan) met Phase III primary endpoint and demonstrated efficacy in slowing kidney function decline in IgAN patients, establishing strong market position in complement inhibitors.
Riliprubart is in Phase III development for CIDP treatment, representing significant pipeline advancement in the expanding complement inhibitors market.

title: IgA Nephropathy Market Forecast to 2036: Novel Therapies and Key Growth Drivers Fuel Expansion | DelveInsight
author: Delveinsight
description: The IgA Nephropathy (IgAN) market is projected to grow at 18.6% CAGR through 2036, driven by rising disease prevalence, improved diagnostics, and a robust pipeline of novel immunotherapies. The market was valued at $1.5 billion in 2025, with recent FDA approvals including VOYXACT and multiple late-stage candidates from major pharmaceutical companies expected to reshape disease management.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Povetacicept shows best-in-class efficacy signals with superior BAFF/APRIL inhibition. Acquired Alpine Immune Sciences for $5B in May 2024, and recently announced collaboration with Ono Pharmaceutical for Japan commercialization.
Felzartamab received European Orphan Drug Designation in November 2024 with key clinical readouts expected 2028-2030. Positioned as disease-modifying therapy targeting CD38-expressing plasma cells.
Atacicept completed Phase III ORIGIN trial enrollment in April 2025 with supportive topline results. Received FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation in May 2024, supporting planned BLA submission.
ULTOMIRIS (ravulizumab) under investigation in Phase III ICAN trial with patent protection extending to 2035-2040 across major markets, offering complement C5 inhibition strategy.

Co-developing Sefaxersen with Ionis Pharmaceuticals, a first-in-class ASO for complement pathway suppression. Exercised licensing option following positive Phase II results with Phase III data expected in 2026.

ARO-C3 in development as RNA interference therapy targeting complement C3 for complement-mediated kidney disorders, representing innovative therapeutic approach.
